elements.label: AI Agent Builder app window (framed card)

elements.manual_reason: No candidate box covers the cursor; it travels with the shrinking window and settles below it.
elements.label: Mouse cursor

pattern.description: After the prompt is filled in, the whole framed app window shrinks (about 80%) and recentres on the dark green backdrop, opening negative space around the UI before the next step.
pattern.why_premium: The UI is treated as a single object on a stage: one smooth scale on the framed card (no camera shake, the backdrop stays still) resets the viewer's focus and signals a new phase without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.app-window', {scale: 0.8, x: '+=10', y: '+=8', transformOrigin: '50% 50%', duration: 0.45, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); cursor follows on the same tween (parent it to the window or tween it alongside, position: '<').
build_hint.remotion: const s = interpolate(frame, [0, 14], [1, 0.8], {easing: Easing.bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); apply transform: scale(s) to the window container; cursor inside the same container.

notes: camera.move is none, so the scale change is the window card shrinking inside a static backdrop, not a camera pull-out. Text inside the window does not change; it only scales with the card.
